info.longName: Calvert US Mid-Cap Core Responsible Index ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities included in the underlying index. The index is composed of common stocks of mid-size companies that operate their businesses in a manner consistent with the Calvert Principles for Responsible Investment.
